mapper.select: SELECT TEMP.BOOKSET_ID AS bookSetId, C.BOOKSET_NAME AS bookSetName, DATE_FORMAT(TEMP.BOOK_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') AS bookDate, concat_ws('',IFNULL(C.BOOKSET_NAME,''),':发生',IFNULL(DATE_FORMAT(TEMP.BOOK_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d'),''),'日交易，请修改会计日期，重新登账！') as reminder FROM (SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID, MIN(A.BOOK_DATE) BOOK_DATE FROM BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING A INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE B ON A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID AND B.BOOKSET_DATE > A.BOOK_DATE WHERE A.IS_ACCOUNTED='N' GROUP BY A.BOOKSET_ID )TEMP LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET C ON C.BOOKSET_ID = TEMP.BOOKSET_ID
